prompt: Create an animation SPRITE SHEET for the exact same pixel-art barbarian in the reference image. Output exactly EIGHT complete sprites arranged in a perfectly regular FOUR-COLUMN by TWO-ROW grid, read left to right then top to bottom. Each grid cell is equal size. Use a wide landscape canvas twice as wide as tall, ideally 2048x1024, so each cell is square. Plain uniform solid gray-blue #8b9bb4 background, NO checkerboard, no grid lines, no labels or numbers. Same character identity, huge muscular hunched upper body, smaller sturdy bent legs, long blond hair flowing down back, dense blond eyebrows covering all eye detail, enormous happy toothy grin, completely clean-shaven bare chin and cheeks, same worn green wrap/belt and brown wrist wraps, ONE knotted wooden club. Pure 90-degree RIGHT-FACING SIDE PROFILE throughout: one cheek visible, nose and mouth point right, chest/hips face right, never turn toward the camera. Consistent chunky pixel-art scale, proportions, palette, hard dark outline and shading across every cell. Keep entire body and entire club inside each cell with at least 10% padding, generous overhead and front clearance. All standing frames share exactly the same ground baseline 85% down the cell and consistent body center. No perspective or camera changes. Do not add secondary figures or duplicate limbs within a cell. Each cell is a separate animation frame. Eight distinct sequential frames of ONE defeat and collapse. Frame 1 hunched high guard; 2 shoulders sag and knees buckle; 3 body lowers heavily and club begins dropping with the gripping hand; 4 one knee reaches the ground; 5 torso pitches onto its side toward the RIGHT; 6 body lands low on the ground, still visible in profile; 7 settles; 8 lies completely still in the final collapsed pose with club beside the gripping hand. No recovery, no standing up, no disappearing, no blood, no gore. Keep the same bare chin, hidden eyes, long blond hair and clothing. All of the body and club fit inside every cell.
